To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) the ppSom gene is regulated at the transcriptional level by cAMP; (2) ppSom gene regulation in primary cerebrocorticocortical neurons is similar to that reported for other cell types; (3) ppSom gene transcription in primary cerebro-cortical neurons is regulated by cAMP in a dose-dependent manner; and (4) ppSom gene expression is regulated in a time-dependent manner by cAMP.
